<infobox theme="Structure">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="name"></title>
	<navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>General information</header>
        <data source="constructed"><label>Constructed</label></data>
        <data source="destroyed"><label>Destroyed</label></data>
        <data source="type"><label>Type</label></data>
        <data source="location"><label>Location</label></data>
        <data source="interest"><label>Point(s) of interest</label></data>
        <data source="rebuilt"><label>Rebuilt</label></data>
        <data source="builder"><label>Builder(s)</label></data>
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Physical specifications</header>
        <data source="height"><label>Height</label></data>	
        <data source="width"><label>Width</label></data>	
    </group>
        <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Chronological and political information</header>
        <data source="affiliation"><label>Affiliation</label></data>
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:Structure|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.

==Usage instructions==
Copy and paste the following code into the top of the article, filling the appropriate fields. Omitted or blank fields will not be shown on the article page.
<pre><nowiki>
{{Structure
|image=
|name=
|constructed=
|destroyed=
|type=
|location=
|interest=
|rebuilt=
|builder=
|height=
|width=
|affiliation=
}}</nowiki></pre>

For articles on ''types'' of structures, such as [[Jedi temple]], the "location" field should specify something like "throughout [[the galaxy]]" rather than comprehensively list every known location.
</noinclude>
